newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Futures discount but beef slipping and see further fund rolling.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cnt. Index lower and corn futures seen little higher.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Cash called steady to higher and pork product prices up. July set new high Thursday.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.500 cent. Firmer cash market, technically strong, light kills and strong stopper.
